name: Dual Citizenship Registration

requirements.blocker_text: Either already a Ugandan citizen acquiring another country's citizenship, or already a citizen of a dual-citizenship-permitting country acquiring Ugandan citizenship -- the second country must itself permit dual citizenship.

evidence_required.document: Proof of dual-citizenship permission from the second country
English or Swahili language proficiency evidence

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Uganda (Embassy of Uganda, Washington DC) -- Citizenship & Dual Citizenship: Uganda permits dual citizenship (holding Ugandan citizenship simultaneously with one other country's), established by the Uganda Citizenship and Immigration Control (Amendment) Act 2009; applicants must be 18+, submit notarized forms, a good-conduct letter, proof of the second country's dual-citizenship permission, a medical/sanity report, English/Swahili proficiency evidence, and residency documentation; a THIRD citizenship disqualifies unless renounced; dual citizens are barred from specified high offices (President, Vice President, Prime Minister, Cabinet Ministers, military/police/security-organization technical heads)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Uganda). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 official diplomatic mission sourced. This is the distinct administrative registration process underlying the dual_citizenship_allowed=TRUE finding applied across ug_citizenship_by_marriage.json, ug_citizenship_by_residence.json, and ug_citizenship_by_descent.json -- Uganda's dual-citizenship framework is RECIPROCAL, not unilateral: it only works if the second country ALSO permits dual citizenship, meaning a Ugandan-origin person from a country with a strict single-citizenship rule cannot use this mechanism regardless of their own wishes. The mandatory 'medical/sanity report' requirement is an unusual, specific documentary requirement not seen in other countries' equivalent processes in this dataset -- flagged rather than omitted. The high-office disqualification list is a genuine structural constraint worth noting for anyone modeling this route for someone with political ambitions in Uganda.
